title: Grill — a multi-threaded, non-blocking Agetor core

threading-model.title: How far should the multi-threading go?
threading-model.display: Full DB worker: every query async

board-refresh.title: How should the board and TUI keep their task lists fresh?

watcher-fix.title: Which changes to the Claude subagent watcher?
watcher-fix.display: Deadline-bound every pass; Read + parse transcripts in the transcript worker; Batch inserts per chunk; Fix the lag label

other-blockers.title: Which other main-thread blockers should this change also fix?
other-blockers.display: Boot: login-shell PATH probe; Request-path file scans; git provider `ssh -G` probe; Recursive rmSync on delete / clone cleanup

block-budget.title: What's the longest the main thread may be blocked by any single unit of work?

health-p95.title: Target /health p95 latency while heavy work runs (opening a long transcript, a big subagent run, the board polling)?

delivery.title: How should it ship?
delivery.display: One PR, one commit per wave

sqlite-cache.title: SQLite memory settings
sqlite-cache.value: `cache_size` 64 MB and `mmap_size` 256 MB on the main connection; the reader worker gets the same.

core-log.title: Persistent core log
core-log.value: `~/.agetor/logs/core.log`, mode 0600, rotated at 5 MB × 3 files, written by a buffered async writer (never a sync write per line), secrets redacted. Every stall ≥ 1 s is logged, with or without a task label.

compact-out.title: Compact database (VACUUM)
compact-out.value: Leave it as it is: manual, refused while a run is active. Out of scope.

busy-banner.title: The busy banner
busy-banner.value: Keep it exactly as it is (observational; 3 s pending plus two missed /health probes).

benchmark.title: Repeatable benchmark
benchmark.value: Add `scripts/measure-core-responsiveness.ts`: a headless core on a `.backup` copy of a real-sized DB in `~/.agetor-dev`, driving the board poll, a transcript replay and a subagent run, reporting /health p50/p95/max and the longest main-thread block, before and after. Never touches ~/.agetor.

e2e.title: E2E coverage
e2e.value: Extend the busy-banner and board specs: a heavy load (big transcript replay + many tasks) runs while the test asserts the board keeps updating and the banner never appears; plus a delta/push spec for the board.

done-means.title: Anything that has to be true before you'd call this done?
